facts.text: I live in rainforests from Mexico all the way to Brazil.
I eat fruits, nuts, seeds and even flowers.
My strong beak can crack open very hard nuts.
Many of us lick clay from riverbanks together.
More than half of me is my long tail!
My squawk is so loud it carries across the forest!
I keep the same best partner my whole life.
People in Costa Rica planted trees to help us.

toys.caption: SQUAWK! I can be very loud!

toys.day: Good morning! Time to fly and find food.
toys.night: Shh... I sleep high up in the trees.
